data.name: Forlorn: The mysteries of Highshadowland
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Highshadowland. Bring snacks. And a shotgun.

 

Jessica Forlorn is not your average monster hunter. She's sarcastic, reckless, and has the survival instincts of a wet cat - but damn, she's good at what she does. When a mysterious letter drags her to the fog-shrouded Highshadowland Island, she finds herself trapped in an abandoned orphanage with more secrets than rooms.

 

Her mission? Find a missing boy.

Her problem? The place is crawling with ghosts, demons, and things that definitely didn't go to Sunday school.

 

From flickering shadows to full-blown exorcism-level freak shows, Jessica's got one rule: Kill it before it monologues.

 

But she's not alone in this fight. Jessica has a sixth sense - a supernatural instinct that reveals hidden objects, secret stashes, and long-forgotten clues. You'll need it to survive.

 

Scavenge every corner for supplies: bandages, rubbing alcohol, painkillers - or just random junk like wood, metal, plastic, and rags. Because sometimes you have to build your own way out. Craft bandages, medkits and sometimes even new ammo for that trusty shotgun.

 

And if you want to uncover the truth? You'll have to read. Notes, diaries, torn pages - the island's dark history is scattered everywhere. Piece together the lore, or just blast your way through. Your call.

 

Forlorn: The Mysteries of Highshadowland is a horror adventure with a twisted sense of humor - think Supernatural meets Evil Dead, with a heroine who's equal parts Buffy, Ash Williams, and a walking headache for anything undead.

 

Explore a sprawling, cursed orphanage. Solve twisted puzzles. Survive jump scares. And try not to laugh when Jessica tells a demon to «wait its turn. »

Features:

 

·       A hand-crafted island to explore - every corner hides a secret

·       Ghosts that don't know when to shut up - and demons that do

·        A heroine with more one-liners than bullets

·       Sixth sense ability - uncover hidden objects and clues

·       Scavenge and loot: bandages, alcohol, pills, wood, metal, plastic, rags, and more

·       Crafting system: medkits and even shotgun ammo

·       Discover the lore through hidden notes and diaries

·       Horror that'll make you scream - and then laugh

·       Boss battles with demons who just won't quit

 

Some islands are paradise. This one wants you dead.

data.short_description: Jessica hunts the supernatural - and roasts them all. Shotgun in one hand, sarcasm in the other. Trapped on a fog-shrouded island, she's got one job: find the missing kid, kick some demon ass, and make the bastard who dumped her here pay. Okay, that's three jobs. But who's counting?
